metadata.title: इंटरव्यू : विनोद निकोले, महाराष्ट्र के सबसे गरीब विधायक | Interview : Vinod Nikole, The poorest MLA
metadata.description: Vinod Nikole is an MLA from Dahanu assembly seat of Maharashtra. According to the affidavit he has given to the Election Commission, he is the poorest MLA in the state. He does not even have a house in the name of property. We have spoken to Vinod Nikole on the tribals of Palghar and their issues.
